Missed: entry gavel_unmissed ok in both runs of the counted pair run-20261123-000330 pair1 / pair2 (round C c3, one build: worldserver 9910c2e52f40, server source at class head c4ec2c2ccd, no C++ change; no flip; cast_failures empty in all trials): 140 Gavels of Wrath 800617 per phase at the dummy, melee_hit_rating 0, expertise_rating 10000 kept, the category cooldown reset before each cast; the control without 300353 landed 130 and 132 of 140 (misses happen), with 300353 learned the gain is 140 of 140 in both runs. Cause of design 1's failure (gavel_unparried at the dummy, removed): the dummy is summoned at the caster's x + 3 with the caster's orientation (CoAGameplayTest.cpp:3496-3499) and, passive, never turns (Unit::SetInFront only from Creature::SelectVictim, Unit.cpp:12884), so the caster stands behind it and Unit::MeleeSpellHitResult clears canParry (!victim->HasInArc(M_PI, this), Unit.cpp:3826-3840); creature 36 has flags_extra 0 (no NO_PARRY). Design 2: the strikes target a defensive striker (entry 36) engaged by Horusath Blast 500154, which then turns to the caster; 100% parry 10019 on it (phase_auras striker, ADR 1228, mentor D-257), caster expertise 0. Control on a non-Gavel melee strike: Justicar's Wrath 806980 (outside 300353's class mask) 0 of 5 landed in each phase, so the striker parries at the forced rate; Gavel of Wrath 0 of 5 without 300353 and 5 of 5 with it. No final status is written in this row; the audit counts the claim by its labels. The empowered effect is carried by the Gavel of Light, Grace and Wrath clauses. Round lr1 (2026-11-23): the empowered-effect claim cites the Holy Form labels of the three Gavel rows: Gavel of Wrath wrath_extra (6 damage events under Holy Form against 1 without it, wrath_extra_control, and 1 without 300353, wrath_extra_nolearn), Gavel of Grace grace_mana (311 mana under Holy Form against 25 without it, grace_mana_control, and 25 without 300353, grace_mana_nolearn) and Gavel of Light light_shield and light_shield_amount (the shield under Holy Form, absent without it, light_shield_control, and before the learn). Reference search 2026-11-23 (the Holy Form empowered effect of the Gavel labels, 34.3): coa-history spell 300353 and Gavel of Wrath 800617: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive, and a spell absent from the logs; positive control: Holy Form 805301 has 39 casts in 14 logs); the sidekick, bindmysoul and ascension-data snapshots under ~/CoaServer/reference carry no sentence for the empowered effect of the Gavels (no match for "Gavels can no longer"); nothing found. clause: Melee critical strikes against you prevent you from being critically struck again for $301342d.

claims.claim: Melee critical strikes against you grant Stalwart 301342 for $301342d
prevent you from being critically struck again

reason: Counted pair 20261122-201141 / 20261122-201215, one build (worldserver 764e5d0be77f, server commit 4cc498eca10f+), no flip, 19 of 19 entries ok in both runs. Stalwart 300355 grants 301342 (DurationIndex 35 = 4000 ms) on a received melee critical hit with damage. A real Strike 11976 (melee) made critical by the Vulnerable 213 fixture (harness set_aura, not the subject) hits the caster; 300355 is learned between the phases, so the before phase is the control (aura absent). The aura is held at 3.62 to 3.75 s after the clock cast and gone at 4.01 to 4.13 s, so 4 s is neither 10% shorter (3.6 s) nor 10% longer (4.4 s). The reads are placed from the DBC duration (4000 ms) and the 10% rule, not from a measured offset: the Strikes land before the clock cast by an offset d >= 0, a duration 10% short never reads held, and a duration 10% long is excluded by the gone read for any d below 270 ms; with four Strikes under +10000% each re-granting 301342 (up to 60 ms later) the residual 2 p^4 leaves p unmeasured. A first pair read the held entry once ok and once alert (a missed strike); the entries then cast four Strikes 20 ms apart with dodge and parry 0, residual about 2 p^4 per pair (1.3e-5 at the 5% base miss chance, at most 0.1% for p up to 0.149; p not measured). The Vulnerable 213 fixture above (Effect[1] aura 197, +10000%) overrides the -1001% of 301342 Effect[0] (net +8999%), so these two entries show the grant and its duration only and each of the four Strikes re-grants the aura (up to 60 ms later, absorbed by the reads); the immunity half is proved by two further entries, counted pair 20261122-205822 / 20261122-205918, one build (worldserver 764e5d0be77f, server commit 4cc498eca10f+), no flip, 4 of 4 entries ok in both runs, cast_failures empty. immunity_no_regrant: fixture Vulnerable 425 (Effect[1] aura 197, EffectBasePoints 99 = +100%, harness set_aura, not the subject) makes the first Strike critical and sums with 301342 to -901%, so no later Strike of the eight (500 ms apart, the last at 3.5 s) is critical; the aura read about 5.4 s after the first Strike is gone (0 in both runs; a re-grant would keep it until at least 7.5 s). Control arm immunity_regrant_control: the same strikes under Vulnerable 213 (net +8999%) leave the aura present at the same read (1 in both runs), so the late read does see a re-grant when critical hits land; the before phase of both entries (300355 not learned) reads 0. Residual failure probability: the gone read fails only if the first three Strikes all miss, p^3 per run, 1.3e-4 at the 5% base miss chance and at most 0.1% for p up to 0.1 (p not measured), the control read fails only if all of Strikes 4 to 8 miss; the pairs' reads exclude a re-grant by more than 2 s. Fixture 425 carries a second effect (Effect[0] aura 325, BasePoints 29) that does not touch the critical chance. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spells 300355 and 301342: no logged event (passive); nothing found beyond the tooltip and the DBC. Placement re-derived from the DBC duration, windows held 3620 to 3750 ms and gone 4010 to 4130 ms after the clock cast: Pair 20261122-230808 / 20261122-230857 (recheck rc1 c1), build 7b299d888600, server commit 346b5c7dbe45+, no flip, 80 of 80 entries ok in both runs, cast_failures empty on every entry changed here. d260: no existing metric gives the Strike landing time against the clock cast: event_first_ms needs since_spell cast by the event's own caster (CoAGameplayTest.cpp:3293-3304), so the striker's landing cannot be timed from the caster's clock cast; claim 1 was held (mentor D-280, review I-1) until the offset was read. Apply stamp (ADR 1236, mentor D-282): an encounter timeline stamps every apply of 301342 on the caster and the clock cast 800722 in one game-time base, and each reading is bracketed from the aura apply: held 3636 to 3767 ms (window 3620 to 3990) and gone 4036 to 4167 ms (window 4010 to 4380) in both runs, first apply 116 ms before the clock cast, 4 and 3 applies (held) and 4 and 4 (gone), none after the clock cast. A held reading from 3620 ms excludes 3.6 s and a gone reading up to 4380 ms excludes 4.4 s whatever the landing offset. Pair prove-20261123-015305 (results 20261123-005311 / 20261123-005410), worldserver b2c2b71cc140, server commit 87f4149ee594, no flip, 4 of 4 entries ok in both runs, cast_failures empty (void_on_cast_failure is an option of the metric_delta kind, metric_delta_options/void_on_cast_failure.py, and is set on the held and gone entries from the c3 round on).
